## What's new in v2.0.48

### No CleanX menu entries under UniWRT
With the CleanX theme installed alongside UniWRT, the UniWRT menu still showed **System → CleanX Theme** (and, before v2.0.47, CleanX's Network Map). Those pages belong to CleanX and only matter while CleanX is the active theme.

UniWRT now leaves all of CleanX's own menu entries out, at every level, exactly as CleanX already does for UniWRT's entries. Each theme shows only its own Network Map and its own settings page. Switch themes under *System → System → Language and Style* to reach the other one.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again, then reload the page.
